entries.name: Starving Reed-born Reedstrider
entries.lore: Hunts where the fen glows brightest; every light it follows was once somebody's last.

entries.name: Gorged Blossomback
entries.lore: It wears the Everbloom's petals the way a hook wears bait.

entries.name: Scarred Lurker
entries.lore: Drawn to bioluminescence like all Gloom-touched things — it hunts prettiest where it is brightest.

entries.name: Pale Cinder-born Sootscale
entries.lore: Sworn to a matriarch's flight; it scouts the glass flowers for trespass.

entries.name: Crown-cold Frostwisp
entries.lore: On the peaks, sound carries for miles; so does its scream.

entries.name: Gloom-marked Zephyrhawk
entries.lore: An avian line of the peaks; it nests above the weather it causes.

entries.name: Coal-hearted Blazeborn
entries.lore: Where it kneels, the ash keeps the shape of prayer.

entries.name: Pale Fenhowler
entries.lore: The drowned forest keeps its bones and lends it new ones.

entries.name: Emberwing Smolderling
entries.lore: Proud and territorial like all Emberkin — it counts the Cinderwastes as inheritance.

entries.name: One-eyed Emberkit

entries.name: Bristling Frost-bound Icemoth

entries.name: Silt-born Oozefang
entries.lore: Mireborn swarm-life: alone it is a nuisance, and it is never alone.

entries.name: Young Echowisp
entries.lore: From the Umbral Depths, where the deeper you go, the more beautiful it gets. It is very deep, and very beautiful.

entries.name: Lithe Hollowgaze
entries.lore: A bloodline the Gloom touched and released — it kept a fragment of the hunger.

entries.name: Lesser Croakmaw
entries.lore: One of the hag-brood: it repeats curses it has overheard, badly.

entries.name: Gorged Hoar-veiled Glacierling
entries.lore: It wears last winter like armor and next winter like a promise.

entries.name: Rabid Croakmaw
entries.lore: Carries a stitched pouch of teeth that are not its own.

entries.name: Hollow Reed-born Sedgeback
entries.lore: It learned patience from the peat: everything sinks eventually.

entries.name: Bloomfell Garlandcat
entries.lore: It pollinates. What it pollinates with is hunters.

entries.name: Lumen-touched Coal-hearted Flamekeeper
entries.lore: It tends fires nobody lit, on altars older than the Havens.

entries.name: Grizzled Nightbloom
entries.lore: It surfaces only where the Lumen pools; beauty is its hunting license.

entries.name: Gloom-marked Lanternjaw

entries.name: Hollow Fenwidow
entries.lore: It trades in names; never tell it yours.

entries.name: Broad-backed Deepshade
entries.lore: What it eats, it first admires.

entries.name: Rabid Gnatling

entries.name: Shard-plumed Vitriolmoth
entries.lore: It grazes the Cinderwastes' glass flowers and grows its armor from the cuttings.

entries.name: Scarred Gale-born Thunderkite
entries.lore: It drops what it catches from a height, out of courtesy to gravity.

entries.name: Silent Icevein

entries.name: Great Cragback

entries.name: Cinderglass Splintercat
entries.lore: Light bends wrong around it; hunters aim at the wrong one.

entries.name: Scarred Shardwing

entries.name: Hollow Vinewretch

entries.name: Night-born Ember-eyed Kindleclaw

entries.name: Lantern-eyed Duskpad

entries.name: Cinder-born Scoriawyrm
